Is your child starting school next September? Come for a tour of our school & Early Years setting. Dates: Monday 21st September- 10am; Thursday 1st October- 11am; Tuesday 13th October- 6pm; Friday 16th October- 2pm; Tuesday 10th November- 10am & Thursday 19th November- 11am. Call the school office to book a place!
Welcome
A very warm welcome to the Pilgrims Cross Primary School website! We are a supportive, caring and welcoming school community, situated on the Picket Twenty development in Andover.
Through our values of Love, Trust and Courage, our vision is that our pupils become positive role-models, to make a positive difference in God's world.
I encourage you to take a bit of time to browse our website to find out more about our school and to get a flavour of what makes Pilgrims' Cross an exciting place to learn. Please do not hesitate to contact us by ringing or emailing the school office for further information or to answer any questions you may have. We would love to hear from you!
Jim Cascarini, Headteacher

SEND & Additional Learning Support
As we know, all children learn in different ways and progress is by no means linear. Many children may experience some form additional need in one or more areas of their learning throughout their time in education. Our teachers do a fantastic job of providing exciting, differentiated learning within the school environment, but we appreciate that you may also want to find ways of giving extra support to children at home. We hope that the links and information which will be shared in this area of our website will give you some ideas about how you might provide additional support or how to access support via other organisations. If you would like specific suggestions then please contact class teachers in the first instance.

Pupil Premium Funding
What is The Pupil Premium?
The Pupil Premium Funding is additional funding allocated to schools to help address inequalities in rates of progress and attainment of vulnerable groups.
It is aimed at closing the attainment gap between pupils from vulnerable families and their peers. It is allocated to schools to work with pupils who have been registered for free school meals at any point in the last six years (known as Ever 6 FSM). Schools also receive funding for pupils from families who are in the Armed Forces or pupils who have been looked after continuously for more than 6 months.
Headteachers and school leaders decide how to use the Pupil Premium funding to meet the particular needs of their pupils and are held accountable for the difference it makes. To learn how Pilgrims' Cross Primary School is currently using the Pupil Premium funding, please follow the link to this year's Strategy Statement.
At Pilgrims' Cross Primary School, we aim to ensure that all children are successful and that any barriers to learning are removed. We are focused on 'closing the gap' in rates of progress and attainment between those children who are receiving Pupil Premium and those who are not.
We invest the Pupil Premium funding received by the school in providing 'additional learning' in small groups, one-to-one booster sessions or through releasing the class teacher to give Pupil Premium children extra teaching. We provide family, emotional and pastoral support and access to enrichment activities such as music lessons and school trips.
We identify barriers which may hinder our Pupil Premium children accessing the curriculum by identifying focus areas, deciding how they will be addressed and assessing their impact. Teachers understand their accountability for the progress of all children. Our Governors monitor the progress of Pupil Premium children and challenge school leaders by holding them to account.

Values and Vision
Vision and Values
At Pilgrims' Cross Primary School, our children are learning, to make a difference, in God's world. Every experience, every interaction and every learning opportunity that our pupils have are designed to help develop our pupils to achieve our Vision- for them to become lifetime learners who make a difference.
Our Values of Love, Courage and Trust are woven throughout our school. From the policies which support the school, through the curriculum, the collective worship, social and learning times together, these Values underpin everything. On a daily basis, in our daily act of worship, our children recite our Vision & Values:
At Pilgrims' Cross Primary School, we are loving, courageous and trustworthy so that we can become talented role-models and make a positive difference in God's world.
We believe that our Vision and Values at Pilgrims’ Cross encompass success and a sense of achievement for all pupils, regardless of their background or the challenges they may face. We believe that Pilgrims’ Cross children are entitled to, and deserve, a broad and balanced curriculum that inspires and provides rich & stimulating learning possibilities. Through the consistent delivery and celebration of our core Values and curriculum we want all our children to acquire the necessary skills and knowledge that will enable them to prosper in the present and flourish in the future. We want all our children and staff to have high aspirations, knowing that there is no limit or ceiling to what is possible and achievable.
